summary: You can act boldly and originally when you choose to. The decisiveness and the nerve are there, switched on when you reach for them.
body: You can act boldly and originally when you choose to. The decisiveness and the nerve are there, switched on when you reach for them. Left idle, you stick to the safe, familiar move. But when you let yourself act on the bold instinct, take the unconventional path, move before the fear catches up, things break open. The opening rewards courage. Reach for it and you stop waiting for permission to make your move.
gift: At your best: bold and original once you decide to move.
shadow: The trap: sticking to the safe, familiar move when a bolder one is right there.
integration: Let drive and anger and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Innovative and fast; the cost is recklessness and volatility.
do: Take the unconventional path on purpose
Move before the fear catches up
